name: Tags
purpose: Surface keyword descriptors that tell the user about an item's content composition and its relationship to a broader content structure. Static Tag (label) or interactive Tag link, with or without a background fill.

props.name: type
props.$note: Tag = static label; Tag link = interactive (navigates/filters), has hover/pressed.

props.name: background
props.$note: Background=true draws a filled chip; false is text-only.

variants.name: tag
variants.use: Static keyword label; font-6 (small) / font-7 (extra-small); optional filled chip.

variants.name: tag-link
variants.use: Interactive tag (filter/navigate); font-6/7 regular-link; default + hover/pressed.

tokens.label: text/default (#333, on-light) | text/reverse (#fff, on-dark) @ font-6/regular (small) / font-7/regular (xs); link uses font-6/7 regular-link
tokens.tag-link-chip (DEPRECATED): on-light interactive (depricate)/on-light/surface/primary/default #fff + /hover #f3f3f3 + border/high-contrast/default+hover #767676; on-dark interactive (depricate)/on-dark/surface/primary/default #333 + /hover #767676 + border/high-contrast #d7d8d6

accessibility.linkPurpose: Tag link must have a clear accessible name and behave as a link/button; static Tag is non-interactive text
accessibility.contrast: Filled chip + label must meet contrast in both modes; text-only tags must be distinguishable from body text if interactive
accessibility.targetArea: Tag link min 44px target despite small visual size

antiPatterns: Making static Tags look interactive (or vice versa)
Leaving tag fills/chips on the deprecated surface tokens — light/dark tag fills have no live subtle-surface equivalent (see tokenValidation)

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.result: DEPRECATED — no dedicated tag/* token group. Tag-link chips use the form-trigger set (clean rebinds); the filled-tag backgrounds hit the recurring no-equivalent subtle-surface blocker (light + on-dark).

tokens.rebind: REVIEW — on-dark surface, no clean live equivalent

blockersNoEquivalent.rebind: REVIEW — no live subtle-surface (Avatar/Headers/List/Nav/Quick-actions gap family)
REVIEW — no live on-dark surface (Avatar/Hero/List gap)

depricateUsage.note: No tag/* semantic group exists. On-light tag links rebind cleanly to the form-trigger family; on-dark tag links + filled tag backgrounds (neutral-2 light / black dark) hit the recurring no-equivalent surface blockers. A dedicated tag/* group (or the missing subtle-surface family) would clean this up.
